description: This file defines the 'TwoFactorConfiguration' entity class, which models configuration settings related to two-factor authentication within the system. It includes annotations for JPA entity mapping and uses Lombok to generate boilerplate code. The class contains methods to retrieve configuration values as appropriate data types.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfiguration
classes.description: Entity representing configuration settings for two-factor authentication, including a name and a value, with methods to interpret the value as a number, boolean, or string.

methods.name: getObjectValue
methods.description: Returns the configuration value cast as an Integer or Boolean based on its name, or as a String if no special type applies.
